self_event_binding.execution_notice: Wire actual value is the canonical execution notice sequence already looked up by Gate. In execution manifest header_template require literal execution_notice=0 placeholder and explicit runtime_bindings.execution_notice=canonical_self_event. Do not predict next seq. This is the second and only non-byte-stable template field besides deadline.
self_event_binding.deadline_unix: Manifest pins literal 0 placeholder plus deterministic min(now+900,leaseexpires-120,windowcloses-120), concrete header durably saved before install intent; observation exact bytes.
self_event_binding.concrete_header_ACK: Not required; source+execution independent review authorizes ONLY these two deterministic field bindings. Informational hash record permissible but not new approval gate. All other header fields and payload files/size/SHA exact manifest match.

qualification_release.required_ack: apoio real independent ACK; active/notdisposed. Root will be asked to issue only this local-candidate-preparation notice, NOT publication/SSH window.

observe_after_expiry: V1 deliberately supports observation ONLY with original current Root window and own live DEPLOY cap. If expired/uncertain report authority blocked; no auto new window, no header rewrite, no mutation retry. Separate explicit readonly recovery scope/source will handle exceptions when concrete. Remote observing permits original expired deadline but local authority is still current.

writer.start_ticks: positive canonical ASCII decimal STRING as /proc/stat, not int
writer.boot_id: UUID string equal original header expected_boot_id; writer_alive false allowed; across reboot original saved identity remains data, no current-runtime qualification
